title: Finite discrete weak Serre hull has filtered constructible presentations
statement: Let A be a finite commutative discrete topological ring in the scheme universe, X a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use the normalized condensed coefficient and internal module category [def-pe-finite-discrete-presentation-encoding] on the pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with the fixed universe [def-weil-size-convention]. If M lies in the weak Serre coproduct closure [sk-def-localizing-closure] of the finite constant scalar-model constructible modules [sk-def-sfb-constructible], then M is an ambient small filtered colimit of such constructible modules. The stages and arrows are internal modules; no lifts of the arrows to finite presentations are required. Empty X and the zero ring are included.

source.place: Refinement (2), first paragraph; the finite discrete subcase of the coefficient-transfer obligation. Stacks Project Tags 03SA(3), 099Y and 09B1 supply the classical comparison route.

proof.text: Choose the normalized encoding and compare its ordinary constructible predicate with fixed-coefficient constructibility. Reindex a pro-etale cover between the two allowed small universes.

The exact fully faithful etale comparison essential image is closed under kernels, cokernels, extensions and coproducts. Every constructible module has an etale antecedent. Minimality of the weak Serre coproduct closure therefore gives an etale antecedent F of M. These closure instances are supplied by EtaleOriginHomology.

Present F as a small filtered colimit of constructible etale modules. Compose its diagram with comparison and inverse encoding; both preserve colimits. Transport the resulting cocone along the antecedent and equivalence isomorphisms. Constructibility comparison identifies every image stage with a finite scalar-model constructible module.
